description: Read a specified lease group and its executed-instrument chain; produce a proposed register revision and explicit exceptions.
trigger: Human requests a named lease group or evidence batch review.
scope: Local or specifically connected OTB evidence; working artifacts only. Contractual interpretations and conflicting sources remain reviewable.
required_inputs: original instruments with stable locator and hash
default_executor: Executor with document reading and structured-output capability
success_conditions: All requested sources inventoried or access failures recorded
Every material assertion carries source and scope
No unresolved conflict is silently resolved
failure_conditions: Authority missing for requested live change
